## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Docs pages open with `[← back to README](../README.md)` (`docs/install.md:3`).
- Merge with merge commits; the `human:merge` gate uses branch ancestry (`docs/install.md` §7 step 2, README `:309-310`).
- Commits are conventional; the pre-commit hook enforces the subject (README `:363`, `docs/hooks.md:13`).
- Smoke guards are written as `grep -qF … || { bad …; x_fail=1; }` then one `ok` line (`tests/smoke.sh:6011-6026`), and new guards are mutation-tested (constitution 3).
